lead.claim: For chronic low back pain, try suspension or biofeedback core training.
lead.context: Why this matters: This RCT compared suspension core training, pressure biofeedback-guided core training, and advice-only for chronic mechanical low back pain.

supporting.claim: Integrate prognostic reasoning into your musculoskeletal practice.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This masterclass article outlines a framework for physiotherapists to incorporate prognostic reasoning into managing musculoskeletal disorders.

supporting.claim: Hip internal fixation and arthroplasty have different recovery patterns.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This retrospective cohort study used sensor-based motion analysis to identify distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories after hip internal fixation versus arthroplasty.

supporting.claim: APPs can manage many musculoskeletal pain patients independently.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This prospective descriptive cohort study evaluated Advanced Practice Physiotherapists' role in a new caregiving model for musculoskeletal pain.

supporting.claim: ACL reconstruction force and power testing varies greatly in research.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This scoping review examined the methods and devices used for force and power testing after ACL reconstruction.
